      • processMakerNote

        public java.util.List<MetadataInspectionEvent> processMakerNote(DirectoryIFD.EntryIFD entry,
                                                                MediaRecord record)
        Parses Apple iOS MakerNote proprietary binary structure from a DNG/TIFF file container.

        Apple MakerNote Binary Layout:

        Apple MakerNote Binary Layout
        Offset / Range Size Description
        Bytes 0–9 10 bytes Preamble signature string "Apple iOS\0"
        Bytes 10–11 2 bytes Version padding / alignment bytes
        Bytes 12–13 2 bytes Byte order marker 'MM' (Big-Endian motorola byte ordering)
        Offset 0x0E (14) 2 bytes Entry Count (unsigned short specifying total IFD attributes)
        Offset 0x10 onward Variable Flat 12-byte IFD entry blocks (Tag ID, Field Type, Count, Value/Offset). Out-of-line data offsets are absolute relative to the start of the MakerNote buffer (0x00).
        Specified by:
        processMakerNote in class CameraMarkerNote
        Parameters:
        entry - the TIFF IFD entry that encapsulates the raw Apple MakerNote byte array to be unpacked
        record - the target media record associated with the inspection batch
        Returns:
        a list of extracted MetadataInspectionEvent items
